units.source_text: 回去的时候，我们默默无言一条街一条街地走着。

en.t: On the way back, we walked street after street in silence.
Then Sensei suddenly began to speak:

units.source_text: “坏了，我是气头上出来喝酒的，妻子一定很担心我。

en.t: This is bad; I came out drinking because I was angry, and my wife must be terribly worried about me.

units.source_text: 想来女人真是可怜，除了我之外，我的妻子就没什么可以依赖的人了。”

en.t: When I think about it, women are truly pitiable; apart from me, my wife has no one she can rely on at all.

units.source_text: 说到这里，先生稍微停顿了一下，但并不像是期待我的回答，紧接着说了下去：

en.t: After saying this, Sensei paused for a moment, but he did not seem to be waiting for my answer and immediately went on:

units.source_text: “这么一说，好像当丈夫的心理有多坚强似的，真是滑稽。

en.t: Saying it that way makes it sound as if a husband's heart is terribly strong, which is really ridiculous.

units.source_text: 我想知道，你是怎样看我的，我给你的印象是强者还是弱者呢？”

en.t: I would like to know: how do you see me? Do I strike you as a strong person or a weak one?
You seem to me to be somewhere between the two, I answered.

units.source_text: 这个回答令先生有些意外，又沉默下来，继续往回走。

en.t: This answer seemed to surprise Sensei a little, and he fell silent again and kept walking back.

units.source_text: 先生回家要路过我的住处，走到附近时，我觉得在路口和先生分手有些过意不去，就说：

en.t: Sensei's way home took him past my lodgings, and when we reached the area I felt bad about parting from him at the corner, so I said:
I will walk with you as far as your house.

units.source_text: 先生马上伸手拦住了我。

en.t: Sensei at once put out his hand and stopped me.

units.source_text: “已经很晚了，你早点儿回去吧。

en.t: It is already very late, so you should go home soon.

units.source_text: 我也得赶紧回家，为了我的太太。”

en.t: I also have to hurry home, for my wife's sake.

units.source_text: 先生最后加上的这句“为了我的太太”神奇般地温暖了我的心，正是由于这句话，我回去后才安然入睡的。

en.t: Sensei's final added phrase, for my wife's sake, warmed my heart in a strange way, and because of those words I was able to sleep peacefully after I got home.

units.source_text: 以后很长时间，我都未能忘记“为了我的太太”这句话。

en.t: For a long time afterward, I could not forget the words for my wife's sake.
